data.gender_notes: Ishanika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ishanika is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ishana’ meaning God and ‘Nika’ meaning rule or ruler. This name signifies the one who rules or governs God. In Hindu mythology, Ishan is a name of Shiva, the supreme deity, symbolizing the ruler of the universe. The name Ishanika carries the meaning “God's ruler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ishanika usually hope their child will grow to embody god's ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ishanika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ishanika total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
